creative_direction: Paint a single white heron standing on one leg in a shallow charcoal ink wash. Construct its curved neck from untouched paper, with one decisive black wing stroke and a tiny ochre beak. Place the bird just right of center, balanced by a short reed on the left. Let the reflection dissolve into a few horizontal marks. Keep the paper warm and lightly fibrous, with empty space above. Avoid an enclosing circle or calligraphic seal. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
